item.title: Tom Green County jail logs: March 24, 2026
item.description: From 7 a.m. on Monday, March 23, to 7 a.m. Tuesday, March 24, 2026, 16 people were booked into the Tom Green County Detention Center.

item.title: Shannon Medical Center offers comprehensive home care services
item.description: Shannon Medical Center offers a range of at home care services, including help with walking, bathing, grooming, hygiene, meal preparation, transportation, medication reminders, and more, with caregivers available 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. on weekdays and weekends.

item.title: San Angelo Planning Commission tables data center regulations
item.description: The City of San Angelo's Planning Commission passed a motion to table an amendment that would adopt land use regulations for data centers, during its Monday meeting.

item.title: Eldorado Young Life seeks permanent home through fundraising
item.description: Eldorado Young Life, a Christian youth organization, is raising funds to purchase a property that would give the organization a permanent home.

item.title: NWS: Thunderstorms could produce large hail, damaging winds
item.description: Isolated to scattered thunderstorms are expected in the Concho Valley Wednesday afternoon and evening, potentially bringing large hail, damaging winds and isolated tornados.

item.title: San Angelo to participate in statewide alert drill
item.description: The City of San Angelo will participate in a coordinated statewide alert and warning drill on Thursday, April 2, from 10 a.m. to 12:30 p.m.

item.title: San Angelo Rodeo to be inducted into the ProRodeo Hall of Fame
item.description: On March 31, 2026, the PRCA announced the 2026 ProRodeo Hall of Fame class. That class included the San Angelo Stock Show and Rodeo under the Rodeo Committee category.

item.title: San Angelo community marks Child Abuse Prevention Month with pinwheel ceremony
item.description: Blue pinwheels spun in the West Texas wind Tuesday, a symbol of hope and the childhood every child deserves.
